roleSelection.title: What's your role?
roleSelection.subtitle: Choose the role that best matches your primary day-to-day work and professional identity. If you wear multiple hats, pick the one you spend the most time in or identify with most strongly.
roleSelection.footer: Don't worry — this selection won't artificially limit or bias your final result. It simply helps us tailor the scenario questions to be more relevant and realistic for your work context, making the test experience more meaningful and relatable.

landing.title: Impulse26.Key
landing.subtitle: Which Impulse26 Key do you have?
landing.description1: Welcome to the Impulse26 Internal Fun Assessment. Through a series of product-work scenarios, you'll uncover your hidden Impulse Key. It might be tied to UX Research, AI Agents, API Experience, Quality Engineering, Customer Issues, or even the mysterious world of HPOM collaboration. This is not a personality test, and it is definitely not an HR tool. It's simply our attempt to use a little dark humor to explain how we take customer experience very, very seriously.
landing.description2: Our goal is to build a comprehensive toolbox that helps cross-functional teams improve their internal execution and collaboration efficiency. Think of it as a 'functional key library' for modern product teams. Each test module represents a special 'key' — a unique combination of decision-making methods, work philosophies, professional instincts, and shared language that defines how you operate in complex product environments. These keys help you understand not just what you do, but why you approach problems the way you do.
landing.description3: Important: For internal entertainment purposes only. Not approved for performance evaluations, promotions, staffing decisions, bonus discussions, finger-pointing exercises, or investigations into who started the last two-hour alignment meeting.
landing.description4: Please don't post this on public social media. This test is meant to spread joy internally. The internet already has enough chaos without us adding more.

distribution.title: Join Our Distribution List
distribution.desc: Connect with a vibrant community of designers, product managers, engineers, and AI practitioners. Get early access to new tools, experiments, and insights about building better product experiences. Share your perspectives and learn from others tackling similar challenges in conversational AI, design systems, and modern UX workflows.

engagement.title: Thinking About More Engagement?
engagement.desc: Join our hands-on workshops every Friday at the Design Hub office in Shanghai. These sessions cover everything from rapid prototyping and user research techniques to AI-assisted design workflows and cross-functional collaboration strategies. Whether you're exploring new tools or refining your craft, there's always something to learn and someone to learn it with.

agenda.title: Check Agenda in Impulse26 CN
agenda.desc: Discover our upcoming events, inspiring talks from industry practitioners, deep-dive workshops on emerging technologies, and unique networking opportunities. The Impulse26 CN community regularly hosts sessions on AI product design, design system architecture, user research methodologies, and the evolving landscape of human-AI interaction. Find your next source of inspiration.

contribution.title: Contribution Guide
contribution.desc: Want to help shape the future of Impulse26? We're always looking for passionate contributors — whether you want to prototype experimental features, share research insights, facilitate workshops, or help improve our internal tools and processes. Check out our open projects, contribute to discussions, or propose new initiatives that align with our mission of building better product experiences.

testIntro.title: How to Play
testIntro.intro1: Answer workplace scenario questions designed to reveal your professional instincts and collaboration style. There are no right or wrong answers — only different approaches that reflect how you navigate complexity in real product work.
testIntro.intro2: After completing the test, you'll unlock your personalized result. It might finally explain why you suddenly go silent in certain meetings, or why you instinctively reach for specific tools when others are still debating.
tips: Choose the option that authentically reflects your instinctive reaction. Your first impulse is usually the most revealing.
Don't try to game the system. Be honest with yourself — it might show you things you haven't fully articulated yet.
Not all Impulse Keys will be revealed before you complete the test. Embrace the element of discovery.
Results are for internal reflection and team conversations only. Please do not share on public social media.
testIntro.footer: May your Impulse Key be clearer than most requirement descriptions.

question.helpText: Trust your instincts — don't overthink it. Your immediate, intuitive reactions are usually the most revealing and authentic. Choose the option that genuinely resonates with how you would respond in the real scenario, not how you think you should respond.
